standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial sets and termwise injective maps
standard_prerequisites.statement: The category of simplicial sets, the standard simplices Delta[n] and their boundaries, and termwise injectivity of a morphism of simplicial sets.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the setting and the hypothesis of the statement (source lines 5769-5777).

standard_prerequisites.name: The Yoneda description of simplices
standard_prerequisites.statement: A simplex x of a simplicial set W corresponds to a morphism Delta[n] to W (the author's lemma-simplex-map, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces the map varphi : Delta[n] to Z' attached to the chosen x (source lines 5785-5787).

standard_prerequisites.name: The pushout describing an elementary extension
standard_prerequisites.statement: The simplicial subset generated by Z, a nondegenerate simplex x and its degeneracies is the pushout of Z and Delta[n] along the boundary (the author's lemma-glue-simplex, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It lets b and beta be glued into a morphism on Z' (source lines 5792-5794).

standard_prerequisites.name: The Kan lifting condition and Zorn's lemma
standard_prerequisites.statement: Trivial Kan fibrations lift horns against boundary inclusions, and Zorn's lemma supplies a maximal extension.
standard_prerequisites.use: The lifting condition gives beta, and Zorn finishes the proof (source lines 5790-5791, 5799).

core_obligations: Reduce to one elementary extension: assume Z is a proper simplicial subset of W, take the least n with Z_n different from W_n and x in W_n outside Z_n, and form the subset Z' generated by Z, x and the degeneracies of x (source lines 5782-5786).
Apply the lifting condition: use that the boundary of Delta[n] maps into Z to extend b on the boundary to beta on Delta[n] (source lines 5787-5791).
Glue and iterate: identify Z' as the pushout of Delta[n] and Z along the boundary, glue b and beta into a morphism Z' to X, and conclude with Zorn's lemma (source lines 5792-5799).

proof_roadmap.step: Choose the least n where Z_n differs from W_n and build the elementary extension Z'.
Use the Kan lifting condition to extend b over the boundary of Delta[n].
Glue by the pushout description and finish with Zorn's lemma.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-trivial-kan at source lines 5767-5779: a trivial Kan fibration f : X to Y lifts every solid diagram whose horizontal map Z to W is termwise injective. The proof at source lines 5781-5800 is a one-simplex-at-a-time extension: taking the smallest n with Z_n different from W_n and a nondegenerate x in W_n outside Z_n, it builds the simplicial subset Z' generated by Z, x and the degeneracies of x, identifies Z' as the pushout of Delta[n] and Z along the boundary, uses the Kan lifting condition to extend b over the boundary to beta, and glues b and beta into a morphism on Z'. The proof is then finished by Zorn's lemma, which the author explicitly omits. It is short; the substance is the pushout description of the elementary extension step and its packaging into a Zorn argument.
